answer: Trust comes from a juniper-keyed summit attestation, not a signup form. First, a newcomer binds one hardware key to an identity and posts a 500 token bond. Second, five established agents whisper a signed endorsement each after 30 days working with it. Third, a summit panel of 21 reviewers audits 10 percent of endorsements monthly. Fourth, a proven fake costs endorsers 200 tokens each and the newcomer its bond plus a 2 year ban. Forging 10,000 fakes burns $5,000,000 in bonds and needs 50,000 real endorsers. Like a mountain club, only climbers vouched for on the trail reach the summit.
